name: @vue-migrate/plugin-vue-extend
description: iter-051: Migrate non-standard Vue 2 dynamic-mount patterns: (1) `new Xxx().$mount(div)` (programmatic component instantiation, e.g. progressBar/detailPanel/dialog overlays) → review + best-effort createApp().mount(); (2) self-recursive function detection (e.g. setCurrentView) → review for stack-overflow risk and Vue 3 refactor hints.
